text.zh-TW: 取自平台分享文案；實際內容、金額與期限以官方公告為準。
text.en: From the platform's share text; actual terms follow the official announcements.

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟推薦連結。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the referral link.

steps.zh-TW: 使用該連結註冊或登入 foodpanda。
steps.en: Sign up or log in to foodpanda through that link.

steps.zh-TW: 完成首張訂單，依活動規則折抵（最高 $50）。
steps.en: Place your first order and receive the discount under the campaign rules (up to $50).

intro.zh-TW: 透過推薦連結註冊 foodpanda，首張訂單最高現折 $50。
intro.en: Sign up for foodpanda through the referral link and get up to $50 off your first order.

description.zh-TW: foodpanda 是外送訂餐平台，可線上選餐並送到指定地點。這是個人化的推薦連結，沒有可手動輸入的短碼，請直接透過本頁的連結註冊或登入，不需要另外輸入任何代碼。首張訂單最高現折 $50，實際內容、金額與期限以官方公告為準。完成首張訂單後依活動規則折抵，連結內的參數本站保持原樣，不做改寫。
description.en: foodpanda is a food delivery platform where you order meals online for delivery to an address you choose. This is a personal referral link with no short code to type in, so sign up or log in through the link on this page and there is nothing to enter by hand. The listed offer is up to $50 off your first order, and actual terms follow the official announcements. The discount applies after you place your first order under the campaign rules, and this site keeps the link's parameters unchanged.

notes.zh-TW: 這是個人化的推薦連結，沒有可手動輸入的短碼，請直接透過連結註冊。連結內的參數本站保持原樣，不做改寫。
notes.en: This is a personal referral link with no short code to type in, so sign up through the link itself. This site keeps its parameters unchanged.
